title: Agent eval row
description: One labelled example for a leafcutter pipeline agent's gold eval set, scored by scripts/evals/run_agent_eval.py. The contract is deliberately agent-neutral: a row is {id, input, expected}. `expected` carries the scorer's payload — for artifact agents that is {negative, gold_target?, assertions[], sandbox_prep?, rubric?, notes?}. This shared schema covers the artifact-mode eval sets (mock-data-author -> evals/mock-data-author/eval.jsonl; flow-author -> evals/flow-author/eval.jsonl). The classifier keeps its richer label-mode schema in classifier-eval.schema.json. `expected` is intentionally open (additionalProperties: true) so scorer-specific keys can be added without a schema bump.

input.description: The natural-language request fed to the agent under test.

expected.description: The expected outcome the scorer checks against. Open-ended so per-scorer keys pass without a schema change.

negative.description: True when this is a bad-input / decline-to-duplicate case. An eval set is incomplete without >= 1 negative case (TQ-200a-4).

gold_target.description: Store-relative path of the gold artifact; enables the --score-gold scorer self-proof.

assertions.description: Deterministic checks the produced artifact must satisfy (TQ-200a-2-ii). Each item names a `kind`; extra keys are assertion parameters.

sandbox_prep.description: Optional per-row sandbox preparation (e.g. remove_artifacts to force the agent to recreate a gold artifact).

rubric.description: Optional LLM-judge rubric applied as a secondary gate, never a substitute for the deterministic assertions.

notes.description: Free-form explanation of what the row measures and why.

ac.description: Optional back-reference to the acceptance-criterion id this row exercises (bidirectional traceability to the AC store). Ignored by the scorer.
